verdicts.explanation: The comment concedes reports are written to local disk as a stop-gap; on ephemeral or multi-instance workers the file is lost or served from the wrong host.
verdicts.suggested_fix: Upload the rendered PDF to object storage and return its key or URL, then delete the comment.

verdicts.explanation: report_title() returns filler text, so every generated report ships with a lorem ipsum title.
verdicts.suggested_fix: Build the title from the report period, e.g. f"Sales report {month:%B %Y}".

new_issues.title: Shell command injection through the report filename
new_issues.explanation: filename is interpolated into a shell command with shell=True; a name like 'x; rm -rf ~' runs arbitrary commands as the worker.
new_issues.suggested_fix: Pass an argument list without a shell: subprocess.run(["convert", filename, out_path], check=True).

new_issues.title: All reports share one fixed /tmp path
new_issues.explanation: Concurrent jobs overwrite each other's output, and a predictable path in /tmp can be pre-created as a symlink by another local user.
new_issues.suggested_fix: Create a unique file with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.pdf', delete=False) and return that path.
